component.name: ShareFolder
component.summary: Share a local folder over the web with peer-to-peer transfers

description.p: ShareFolder turns a folder on your computer into a private download link. People you share with receive files directly from your machine over an encrypted peer-to-peer connection — nothing is uploaded to a central server.

ul.li: Pick any local folder and get a link you can send
Transfer files peer-to-peer with live progress
Keep sharing under your control; stop anytime by closing the app

description.p: Fix release CI lockfile sync. No application menu in packaged builds on any platform.
Remove the application menu entirely in release builds on all platforms, including macOS.
Hide the File/Edit menu bar in release builds. Keep App Center packaging improvements from 1.0.6.
